fields.description: Issue features an investigative report alleging abuse and criminal conduct by a Miami physician operating a purported psychiatric clinic, including accounts of violence against patients and other misconduct. Editorial and civic coverage includes Miami City Commission actions regarding annexation/incorporation proposals involving Biscayne Key and Virginia Key, commentary on anti-communist publicity, and discussion of municipal affairs. Local court and public-safety items report on arrests and hearings, public health concerns (including fluorescent light hazards and watered milk), and community events and advertising tied to the Dade County Fair and Miami-area entertainment and nightlife.
